Micro units credit scheme extended for ﬁve years krity ambey New Delhi, 11 November The Union Cabinet on Wed- nesday approved the continu- ation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) for ﬁve years under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY). The Cabinet also approved a corpus of ~5,000 crore to facili- tate loans under the scheme. “The scheme provides credit guarantee coverage to the Lending Institutions through National Credit Guar- antee Trustee Company Li- mited (NCGTC) against de- fault risk,” the government said in a press release. The scheme which will now remain operational until March 31, 2031, is ex- pected to facilitate loans worth ~12.6 tril- lion under PMMY over the ﬁve-year period. “As of Septem- ber 2026, over 60.36 crore loans amounting to ~43.34 trillion have been sanc- tioned by lending institutions since the launch of PMMY,” the release said.
